title: Feature Engineering
motto: A good feature is worth a thousand data points.

steps.title: Core idea
steps.body: A good feature is worth a thousand data points.

steps.title: Why this matters
cards: You have a dataset. You pick an algorithm. You train it. The results are mediocre. You try a fancier algorithm. Still mediocre. You spend a week tuning hyperparameters. Marginal improvement.
Then someone transforms the raw data into better features and a simple logistic regression beats your tuned gradient-boosted ensemble.
